#!/bin/fish
# music player implemented in fish

set progname "musicfish"
set version "0.1"

# CHANGE this path
set path_to_nfdb "./notefreq.fish"

if test -r $path_to_nfdb
 source $path_to_nfdb
else
 set_color --bold red
 echo "!!! The note frequency database ('$path_to_nfdb') is not in the"
 echo "!!! current directory. Either move it, or reinstall it."
 set_color normal
 exit 1
end

if command --search beep >/dev/null 2>&1
 true
else
 set_color --bold red
 echo "!!! The 'beep' command does not exist."
 echo "!!! Check your PATH variable, or install the program."
 set_color normal
 exit 2
end

if test (count $argv) -lt 1
 set_color --bold red
 echo "!!! You must specify a musicfish file to read."
 set_color normal
 exit 3
end

if test $argv[1] = "--verbose"; or test $argv[1] = "-v"
 if test (count $argv) -lt 2
 set_color --bold red
 echo "!!! You must specify a musicfish file to read."
 set_color normal
 exit 3
 end

 set verbose 1
 set inputfile $argv[2]
else
 set verbose 0
 set inputfile $argv[1]
end

if test $verbose -eq 1
 set_color --bold green
 echo -n "[$progname] "
 set_color normal

 echo "$progname version $version"
end

for line in (cat $inputfile)
 echo $line | read --array bline

 if test $bline[1] = "#"
 continue
 else if test $bline[1] = "wt"
 if test $verbose -eq 1
 set_color --bold green
 echo -n "[$progname] "
 set_color normal
 echo -n "Wait "
 set_color --bold white
 echo -n $bline[2]
 set_color normal
 echo " milliseconds"
 end

 sleep (math -s3 $bline[2]/1000)
 continue
 end

 if test $verbose -eq 1
 set_color --bold green
 echo -n "[$progname] "
 set_color normal
 echo -n "Playing note "
 set_color --bold white
 echo -n $bline[1]
 set_color normal
 echo -n " on octave "
 set_color --bold white
 echo -n $bline[2]
 set_color normal
 echo -n " for "
 set_color --bold white
 echo -n $bline[3]
 set_color normal
 echo " milliseconds"
 end

 set notevarname {$bline[1]}_{$bline[2]}
 beep -f $$notevarname -l $bline[3]
end
